observations: Photo 0 shows a label from a solar photovoltaic module.
The label reads 'JinKO Solar' and 'PHOTOVOLTAIC MODULE' with model 'JKM400M-72HL4-V'.
Rated power is 400W, made in China, with CE and PV Cycle marks.
Photo 1 shows the front of a solar panel with dark blue cells and a silver frame, standing upright among other panels.
The panel appears to be in good condition with no visible cracks or damage.
Watermark 'EMMYDON SOLAR ENERGY' is present on both photos.

claims.claim: Solar equipment such as solar panels, battery, inverter and charger...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a solar panel, which is part of the claimed solar equipment.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in photos, such as microcracks in cells or frame corrosion.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the panel surface and frame edges under bright light, including the backsheet and junction box.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged, which may reduce value

risks.risk: Panel not functioning or degraded performance due to age or storage conditions.
risks.proof: Video of the panel being tested under sunlight with a multimeter or power meter showing output.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, which may reduce value

risks.risk: Missing or damaged junction box, connectors, or wiring.
risks.proof: Photo of the back of the panel showing the junction box and cable connections.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or requiring repair

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the panel showing the junction box and cables.
Video or photo of the panel being tested under sunlight with a power meter.
Close-up photos of the panel edges and frame for signs of damage or corrosion.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a JinKO JKM400M-72HL4-V 400W solar panel. All seller claims are supported by the label in photo 0. Hidden risks exist but are common to second-hand solar panels; the item can be priced at its worst case (as potentially damaged or non-functional) until further proof is provided.
